title: CheckpointIndex
description: index.json manifest for a folder of checkpoints: a static deployment of the viewer, a Cirro dataset upload, or a public project in the web app (DESIGN.md §14.3, backend/app/cirro.py:_write_viewer_index, frontend/src/data/checkpointIndex.ts, cirro-studio/src/data/indexFolder.ts). Documented in docs/CHECKPOINT_FORMAT.md.

description.description: What the folder holds; the web app shows it with the public project.

id.description: A name for the checkpoint that other entries' `from` can use; defaults to its path.

path.description: Resolved relative to this index.json's own URL.

folder.description: The folder the web app files the checkpoint under on its map.

from.description: The checkpoints this one was made from, by id or path: its lineage, drawn on the web app's map.

tags.description: Plain-text tags the web app shows and searches.

date.description: When the checkpoint was made, as an ISO date.

size.description: The file's size in bytes, when the host doesn't say.

credit.description: Whose data the checkpoint is made from, under what license, and what was done to it. Any of the six fields; the web app shows a credit that names a source or a license.

source.description: The dataset as its publisher titles it.

changes.description: What was done to the data to make the checkpoint.
